step1_analysis.description: A first-order active all-pass filter used as a time-delay cell. It utilizes a feedforward transconductance path (XM1) and a current mirror (XM4, XM5) to create a right-half-plane zero that mirrors the left-half-plane pole, providing a flat magnitude response with a frequency-dependent phase shift.

paper_reference.title: A 1-to-2.5GHz Phased-Array IC Based on gm-RC All-Pass Time-Delay Cells

sky130_expected.calculation: DC gain = gm1/gm3. With identical sizing for XM1 and XM3, the gain is 1 (0 dB).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Designed for unity gain to allow cascading multiple delay cells without signal attenuation or saturation.

sky130_expected.calculation: Phase shift at 1 GHz is approx -96 degrees based on the dominant pole wp1 = gm4/C1. Delay = (96/360) * 1ns = 267 ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the pole frequency. With L=0.5u, C1 is relatively large, giving ~250ps delay per cell.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the second pole at VOUT: wp2 = gm3/C2. With gm3=1.29mA/V and C2~100fF, fp2 ~ 2 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The all-pass nature keeps the gain flat until the parasitic pole at the output node takes effect.
Calculated based on Vov~0.5V and the required W/L ratios in SKY130 to maintain the all-pass condition (gm5 = 2*gm4).

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC gain, bandwidth, phase shift, and transient delay of the all-pass cell.
step3_testbench.spice:
* All-Pass Delay Cell Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Parameterized W/L for all-pass condition (gm2*gm5 = 2*gm1*gm4)
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=20u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=40u L_xm5=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 VOUT VIN GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N1 VIN GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 VOUT VOUT GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N1 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 VOUT N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVIN VIN 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 SIN(0.9 0.1 1G 0 0)

.control
  * OP Analysis
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * AC Analysis
  ac dec 100 1Meg 10G
  let gain_db = vdb(VOUT)
  let phase_deg = 180/PI * cph(v(VOUT))
  
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1Meg
  meas ac gain_1G find gain_db at=1G
  meas ac phase_1G find phase_deg at=1G
  meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=-3 fall=1

  * Transient Analysis
  tran 10p 5n
  meas tran delay_tran trig v(VIN) val=0.9 rise=2 targ v(VOUT) val=0.9 rise=2
  
  quit
.endc
.end
